title: Filtered colimits of flat module sheaves are flat
statement:
Let $(C,J)$ be a site small in a coefficient universe $w$, let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on it, and let $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ denote sheaves of $R$-modules with section groups in $w$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $I$ be a $w$-small nonempty directed poset (any two elements have a common upper bound), and let $(P_i,p_{ij})_{i\le j}$ be a diagram in $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$. Suppose every $P_i$ is flat, meaning that the sheaf tensor functor $P_i\otimes_R-$ is exact [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $q_i:P_i\to P$ is any colimit cocone in $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], then $P$ is flat. In particular, for every finite diagram $D$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, the canonical comparison
$$P\otimes_R\lim D\ \longrightarrow\ \lim(P\otimes_R D)$$
is an isomorphism, including when $D$ is empty. No sectionwise-flatness or enough-points hypothesis is imposed.
